goal: Stop rebroadcasting wallet transactions that are already continuously present in the local mempool
Prevents redundant transaction announcements that leak user IP addresses and wallet ownership to peers
reviewability: Reviewable now; nothing invalidates a review though author fixes to test assertions are expected
agreement: Unaddressed objection: test assertions check txids against wtxid invs and never fail (polespinasa)
Nonblocking objection: replacement probing still allows address deanonymization (mzumsande)
Support for being an obvious privacy improvement (murchandamus)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a long-standing privacy leak linking node IP addresses to unconfirmed transactions
Protects node operators from peers deducing wallet ownership via redundant periodic announcements
